description.text: At the left edge of a quiet snow-covered street,

rolls into view. Its black body and carbon fibre panels catch the pale winter light as the tyres press two dark tracks through fresh slush. Snowflakes drift across the frame, settling on the curb and on the low banks of snow that line the road. Bare trees stand behind a row of dark windows, and the street surface shines where the slush has been packed smooth. The car advances from left to right, its nose lifting slightly over the uneven ground. By the end of the shot it has cleared the curb line and settled into a steady roll, with a soft crunch under the tyres and the low hum of the engine.
begins to ease forward into the snowy street.
A low engine idle hums under the soft crunch of tyres on fresh snow.
Snowflakes drift past as the car clears the curb line and settles into a steady roll.
Tyres compress fresh snow with a soft crunch; the engine idle remains low and steady.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

accelerates along the snowy street, passing shuttered shopfronts with frosted awnings. Cold light catches the carbon fibre body and the wet black panels as the car builds speed. Slush sprays from the rear tyres in a bright arc, and snow dust hangs in the air behind it. The shopfronts slide past in the background while the car holds the center of the street. Near the end of the shot the engine note rises and the tyres throw a wider fan of snow, carrying the car toward the next stretch of road. The car's motion stirs the loose snow along the gutter and leaves a ragged wake behind it.
accelerates along the snowy street, passing shuttered shopfronts.
The engine note rises, and slush sprays from the rear tyres.
The rear tyres kick up a fan of snow as the car sweeps past the storefronts.
The camera pans right with small amplitude at fast speed.

leans through a gentle bend, then draws away down the snow-lined street. Fresh curved tracks remain behind it, cutting through the slush. Falling snow softens the car's outline as it becomes a small dark shape in the distance. Wind moves loose snow across the road, and the engine note fades under the hush of the snowfall. The street empties behind the car, leaving only the curved tracks and the drifting flakes. The last visible movement is the car's dark form receding between the snow banks as the wind lifts a thin veil of white across the road.
leans through a gentle bend, its shape drawing away down the snow-lined street.
The engine note fades under wind and soft snowfall.
Fresh curved tracks remain behind as the car becomes a small dark shape in the falling snow.
The camera holds a static shot.
